messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm drafting the release notes for the docs site push tomorrow. Focus: migration guides, SDK snippet refresh, and link fixes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489
liam: I can review the SDK snippets today. Will run the quick smoke tests against the python + js examples.
sam: I'll do a link sweep and patch redirects for any old anchor URLs. Found one broken embed in the embed migration guide last night.
caroline: For known issues, we should call out: 1) embeddings streaming flag still toggled; 2) legacy python client example uses old params; 3) Windows users may hit a path length issue in the install section.
maya: good notes. I'll add a short "known issues" section under the whatsnew blurb and link to the workaround for Windows.
liam: Quick snippet change for Python SDK — use new client name `from redwood import RedwoodClient` instead of `from redwood_api import Client`. Minimal sample:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
resp = client.generate("Summarize the quarterly metrics")
print(resp.text)
```
liam: confirm this works with v0.9.7 of the SDK; I'll push a tiny PR for the sample.
maya: assign reviewers: @liam on snippets, @sam on links, @caroline on whatsnew + known-issues copy. I'll handle the release blurb and changelog header.
sam: link sweep plan: run `yarn docs:linkcheck`, then manual for external redirects. Will open a follow-up PR with fixes.
docs-bot: deploy-canary started for docs site at 2026-03-25T14:20:00Z — URL: https://canary.docs.redwood.com — status: building
caroline: also add a rollback note: if the canary shows broken code blocks, run `./scripts/rollback_docs_canary.sh` and ping eng-docs.
maya: for changelog bullets, keep it short: - Migration guide for embed streaming - SDK snippet updates (py/js) - Link fixes and redirect cleanup - Known Windows path issue.
liam: tiny nit: call out SDK version compatibility: "Client example updated for SDK v0.9.7+" under each sample.
sam: found two stale anchors in migration guide: `#embed-legacy` and `#kv-cache-note`. Will include redirects in the PR.
maya: target: merge PR today by 18:00 PST, canary deploy 19:00 PST, final publish after green canary and signoff.
caroline: acceptance checks before publish: sample smoke tests green, linkcheck < 2 failures, whatsnew copy + known issues reviewed.
liam: I'll run smoke tests after I push the snippet PR. Expect 30m.
sam: link PR ready in draft, will convert to ready-for-review once liam signals snippet PR merged.
docs-bot: canary build completed — checks: linkcheck=1 warning, build=ok, smoke-tests=partial (python samples failed due to old import).
maya: thanks bot. Liam — can you re-run tests after your PR lands?
liam: on it. Pushed fix for import, re-running smoke tests now.
docs-bot: smoke-tests passed for python and js samples.
maya: everything looks good. I'll merge and start final publish in 15.
caroline: adding a short rollback script into the release notes (copy the command into the doc incase ops needs it).
maya: merged and publishing. Will post the whatsnew link in #general once live.
sam: quick reminder — preserve redirect rules for `old-embed-guide` to new path; don't remove until 2 weeks after publish.
liam: noted. Approved from my side :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all — tagging this as done once the public link is up. :shipit:
